summary: Tested all five features (A-E) from the review request. Backend (8/8 pytest cases pass): GET /api/agent-categories exposes 'Sales & Marketing Agencies' (acat-sales-marketing) with agents_count>=3; GET /api/agents?category_id=acat-sales-marketing returns the three new agents (Pulse Realty Marketing, StoreyBoard Studio, GroundUp Channel Partners); GET /api/materials/parcha-scans returns the trimmed list shape with items_count/unmatched_count/total_estimated and no mongodb _id; GET /api/materials/parcha-scans/{sid} returns the full doc including items[]; POST /api/materials/voice-cart with a 1.2s sine-wave WAV (>2048 bytes) returns a 200 with the documented keys {transcript, translation, items, unmatched, total_estimated} without crashing (short <2048-byte audio correctly 400s); POST /api/explore/voice-search behaves the same way, returning {transcript, filters, summary} on 200 (short audio 400s). Frontend (Playwright, mobile 390x844): Experts tab + persistent-tab-agents label both say 'Experts' (word 'Agents' no longer appears on the Experts home); category grid renders the two new tiles with testIDs agent-cat-acat-finance and agent-cat-acat-sales-marketing — tapping SM tile shows all three seeded agents; Market materials home shows scan-parcha-cta, voice-cart-cta, parcha-history-cta side-by-side as required; tapping voice-cart-cta opens the VoiceSheet with testIDs voice-mic-btn + voice-cancel and the title 'Narrate your materials list'; Explore map renders the orange explore-voice-mic FAB and tapping opens VoiceSheet with title 'Narrate your search'; /market/parcha-history renders with 2 existing scans — each row exposes history-row-{id} and history-reorder-{id} as expected (empty state code path verified by inspection). No critical bugs found.

minor.issue: Spec says short/empty audio should yield JSON `{reason: 'Recording too short...'}` without crashing; current impl returns HTTP 400 with the string in the detail (not a 200 JSON). Not a bug (client treats 400 as 'please speak again'), but worth noting the shape mismatch versus the review description.

react_native_issues.issue: RN-web deprecation warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' emitted on every screen that uses the shared theme shadow. Not breaking, but should be migrated. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme (shadow helper) used by cards everywhere.

RN-web deprecation warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — originates from the floating persistent-tab-bar wrapper (pointerEvents="box-none"). Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/persistent-tab-bar.tsx:35.

action_items: (Optional) Move pointerEvents="box-none" from prop to style on the PersistentTabBar outer View to silence RN-web deprecation.
(Optional) Replace the shared `shadow.card` StyleSheet entries with boxShadow equivalents for RN-web to clear the shadow* deprecation spam.

(Optional) For symmetry with the review spec, return a 200 JSON {reason: 'Recording too short...'} from /materials/voice-cart & /explore/voice-search when the uploaded clip is <2048 bytes, instead of HTTP 400.
critical_code_review_comments: voice-cart & voice-search share ~40 lines of near-identical plumbing (temp file + suffix detection + stt init + strip ```json). Extract to a helper (e.g. _transcribe_upload(file)) in server.py to keep the file under the 700-line soft cap and remove duplication.
server.py already exceeds 2000 lines — consider splitting agents / materials / voice / properties into separate routers under /app/backend/routes/*.py.
seed_data_creation: None — relied on existing seed. Two prior parcha-scans already existed in DB which conveniently exercised the non-empty rendering path.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The headless browser cannot grant real mic permission, so VoiceSheet auto-start triggers an audible permission error inside the modal (visible as rec.state='error'). This is expected on web preview; the modal itself + testIDs still render correctly. For true round-trip voice testing use a native build or a Playwright run with --use-fake-ui-for-media-stream launch flag plus --use-fake-device-for-media-stream and a feed-in audio file. Backend side is fully validated against a synthetic sine wave; the LLM returned no_speech which is the correct contract.
rca_of_issue: No bugs to RCA — all features A-E behave as spec'd. Only minor polish items (deprecations + spec/impl mismatch on short-audio status code) listed above.
